about: Bought parts of design v6.3 in English, Italian and German. Rendered by site/bom.py into docs/BOM.md and the site page parts/. Each 'match' lists items of the bought-parts list of the print package (plates/summary.json, bought_parts, which collects v63.json and the earlier design data): their quantities must add up to 'qty', and every item of that list must be matched somewhere.

note.en: Stainless steel throughout. In the kit the dispenser unit and the flange set come assembled: you only need the wood screws and the cable tie.
note.it: Tutto in acciaio inox. Nel kit l'unità dosatrice e il set flangia arrivano montati: servono solo le viti da legno e la fascetta.
note.de: Durchgehend Edelstahl. Im Bausatz kommen Spendereinheit und Flanschsatz montiert: ihr braucht nur die Holzschrauben und den Kabelbinder.
